strings.It glows like the last of the sun: a Du: 它像落日余晖般发光：暮金光泽形态！
strings.It is washed in deep ink: an Inkwash Gl: 它浸染着浓墨：墨染光泽形态！
strings.Its colours never hold still: an Opalin: 它的颜色从不停歇：蛋白石光泽形态！
